name: Multi-pass GPU Ray Casting on Virtual Globe
aliases: GPU-based Direct Volume Ray-Casting on Virtual Globe
Spherical Volume Texture on Virtual Globes
definition: A multi-pass GPU ray-casting technique that renders 3D volumetric data stored in spherical coordinates onto a virtual globe by transforming bounding box positions to Cartesian space, generating rays in Cartesian coordinates, and sampling the spherical texture front-to-back.
summary: Multi-pass GPU Ray Casting on Virtual Globe renders spherical volumetric data by transforming irregular coordinates to Cartesian space for accurate ray generation and sampling.
